-- Spec helper: the pure meaning of swapping the ends of a list.
first_last_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex first_last_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex first_last_swapped([5, 9]) == [9, 5]
  ex first_last_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex first_last_swapped([]) == []
  if xs.len() < 2
    return copy xs
  var ys = copy xs
  swap_ends(&ys)
  ys

-- Swaps the first and last elements of xs in place.
-- Empty and one-element lists are unchanged.
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  if xs.len() < 2
    return
  let last = xs.len() - 1
  let t = xs[0]
  xs[0] = xs[last]
  xs[last] = t

test_swap_ends() =
  var a = [1, 2, 3]
  swap_ends(&a)
  assert a == [3, 2, 1]
  var b = [7]
  swap_ends(&b)
  assert b == [7]
